scope: actual own launchers; private root substituted, no credentials

fnit-sphere-sse-full-v6.sh.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
FNIT_FLOAT_ROOT=${FNIT_ROOT}
source "$FNIT_FLOAT_ROOT/logs/recon_runtime_env_20261009.sh"
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 MKL_NUM_THREADS=4 NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=4
unset PYTORCH_NO_CUDA_MEMORY_CACHING
export NUMBA_CACHE_DIR="$FNIT_FLOAT_ROOT/workspaces/sphere_reference_d932c45_20261010_v4/numba_float_bbox_v6"
mkdir -p "$NUMBA_CACHE_DIR"
FNIT_FLOAT_WS="$FNIT_FLOAT_ROOT/workspaces/sphere_reference_d932c45_20261010_v4/float_bbox_v6"
FNIT_FLOAT_SCRIPT="$FNIT_FLOAT_WS/validation/recon_all/optimizations/20261010_sphere_overlap_full_stop/trace_standard_sphere.py"
FNIT_FLOAT_RUN="$FNIT_FLOAT_ROOT/runs/sphere_reference_d932c45_20261010_v4"
taskset -c 116-119 "$FNIT_FLOAT_ROOT/envs/recon_main_20261009_v3/bin/python" "$FNIT_FLOAT_SCRIPT" --source-directory "$FNIT_FLOAT_WS/src" --inflated "$FNIT_FLOAT_ROOT/runs/recon_python_profile_20261010_v4/sub07-candidate/subject/surf/lh.inflated" --smoothwm "$FNIT_FLOAT_ROOT/runs/recon_python_profile_20261010_v4/sub07-candidate/subject/surf/lh.smoothwm" --output "$FNIT_FLOAT_RUN/sub07-sse-float-full-v6" --averaging-device cuda:0 --finish-device cuda:0 --bbox-mode source_float --coordinate-checkpoints 8 --capture-update 39 --capture-update 420 --diagnostic-native-checkpoints "$FNIT_FLOAT_RUN/sub07-native-trace-v1/surf"

taskset -c 116-119 "$FNIT_FLOAT_ROOT/envs/recon_main_20261009_v3/bin/python" "$FNIT_FLOAT_SCRIPT" --source-directory "$FNIT_FLOAT_WS/src" --inflated "$FNIT_FLOAT_ROOT/workspaces/sphere_reference_d932c45_20261010_v4/normal_frozen_public_v1/surf/lh.inflated" --smoothwm "$FNIT_FLOAT_ROOT/workspaces/sphere_reference_d932c45_20261010_v4/normal_frozen_public_v1/surf/lh.smoothwm" --output "$FNIT_FLOAT_RUN/normal-sse-float-full-v6" --averaging-device cuda:0 --finish-device cuda:0 --bbox-mode source_float --coordinate-checkpoints 8 --capture-update 39 --capture-update 420 --diagnostic-native-checkpoints "$FNIT_FLOAT_RUN/normal-native-trace-v1/surf"
